notablePrerequisites:
You have lost at least 4 life this turn.
Rowan does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn by at least {4}.
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {B} due to Rowan's ability.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Lab Rats, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token and returning Lab Rats to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat from step 2.
